body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsin innotec presented ''SBS-6600'' a portable Bluetooth stereo speaker during KES 2006. It supports Bluetooth 2.0 connectivity, ASDP profile, and 8 hours of play time.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
